parameters.name: PacketsSent
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully sent from the NTP server to the NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsSentFailed
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that were not successfully sent to the NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsReceived
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that have been successfully received by the NTP server from a NTP client.

parameters.name: PacketsDropped
parameters.description: Specifies the number of packets that were received by the NTP server but were not successfully processed or handled due to errors or other issues.

object.description: This object specifies the statistic parameters for the NTP server. {{bibref|RFC9249|Chapter 8 NTP Yang Module}}
